mapper.select: SELECT equipment_idx, equipment_name, equipment_standard, equipment_cnt, facility_idx, homepage_id, add_date, add_id, modify_date, modify_id FROM FACILITY_EQUIPMENT WHERE facility_idx = #{facility_idx} AND homepage_id = #{homepage_id} ORDER BY facility_idx ASC
